scope: Immutable original hard/warning groups; not the current loader or a recommendation to install them.

rules.title: CAP_001 mandatory
messages: Positive nest-linked captures normally leave gps_id and gps_point blank and use the nest location. If an adult was captured with chicks from this nest, enter both GPS fields and record the chicks in caught_with (for example, 2C).
Required capture field.
An age-C first-capture event (capture_status F) must include a positive nest_id or a negative nest_id (i.e., found at the brood stage).
Age-C recapture events must record the release time.
Negative nest_id values identify broods found after hatching and require both gps_id and gps_point because there is no NESTS location.
An adult captured with chicks from a positive nest must record both gps_id and gps_point because the capture may be away from the nest.
Age-C R and C capture events must record both gps_id and gps_point, even when nest_id is entered.
A GPS ID and GPS point are required when this capture is not linked to a positive nest.
gps_id and gps_point must be entered together when a positive-nest chick is captured away from the nest or an adult is captured with chicks.

rules.title: CAP_009B family nest ids
messages: Could not verify whether this capture shares one nest_id with the other parent/chick records from the same date, site, gps_id, and gps_point. Confirm the linkage and retry after the database connection is restored.

This same family occasion contains conflicting nest_id values across the parent/chick records. Keep one nest_id for the same date, site, gps_id, and gps_point; use a different nest_id only for a separate encounter or a genuinely different brood association.

rules.title: CAP_001B uncertain marks
rules.messages: CAPTURES leg-mark fields cannot contain '?'. Record known marks, X for an observed empty position, or leave the position blank where the current layout permits it.

rules.title: CAP_001A ring format
rules.messages: Ring must use CP followed by five digits, with an optional dash, e.g. CP12345 or CP-12345.

rules.title: CAP_006C HA adult capture
messages: Age-A captures using capture_method HA require a positive nest_id.
Age-A captures using capture_method HA require a capture time before 07:00 or after 19:00.

rules.title: GLOBAL_002 season
rules.messages: Date must fall within the 2026-2027 field season.

rules.title: GLOBAL_003 site
rules.messages: Site must be a valid BDOT site code.

rules.title: GLOBAL_005A gps points
messages: Could not confirm gps_id and gps_point against GPS_POINTS. Confirm the GPS was uploaded via gpxui before entering events.
gps_id and gps_point must already exist in GPS_POINTS. Upload the GPS first via gpxui.

rules.title: GLOBAL_004 system blank
rules.messages: Validation flag must stay blank.

rules.title: CAP_002 observer active
rules.messages: Observer must exist in OBSERVERS and be active on the capture date.

rules.title: CAP_003 004 book form
messages: book_id must be one of 1 to 5.
form_id must be a positive integer.
Each [book_id, form_id] pair must represent only one capture event.

rules.title: CAP_005 time order
messages: Released must be blank when capture_status is D.
Caught must be before released.

rules.title: CAP_006 status
rules.messages: capture_status must be F, R, C, or D.

rules.title: CAP_006B method nest
messages: capture_method TN requires a positive nest_id.
capture_method TB requires either a positive nest_id or a negative nest_id (i.e., found at the brood stage). Please check the nest linkage.

rules.title: CAP_009 nest id
messages: NO_NEST is no longer accepted. Leave nest_id blank for an unrelated capture and enter both gps_id and gps_point, or enter the appropriate positive or negative nest_id.
nest_id must be blank or match the current site-specific positive/negative nest_id format.

rules.title: CAP_010 field sex
rules.messages: field_sex must follow the age-specific coding rule.

rules.title: CAP_013 014 017 marks
messages: First-marking captures must have all input band positions set to X or left blank.
First-marking captures must not leave all release band positions as X.
Statuses R and C require all input and release band positions to be entered.
Looks like you changed the bands on this bird after recapture, capture_status should be 'C'
Recaptures with status R must keep the same band positions before and after handling.
Status C requires at least one non-X input mark before the release combo is changed.
Status C requires at least one change between input and release band positions.
Dead-on-capture rows must record the recovered combo in all input band positions.
Dead-on-capture rows must leave all release band positions blank.
Only one T allowed across upper leg positions.
T codes are only allowed in upper leg positions.
CR
CR chick captures must use LL as a single colour, UR as M, and blank UL/LR positions, with status F or R.
Non-CR chick captures must use UL as M, LR as a single colour, and blank LL/UR positions, with status F or R.
Juvenile captures must use a flag code on UL, blank LL/LR positions, UR as M, and status F or C.

Juvenile captures must use a flag code on UL, blank LL/LR positions, and UR as M for status F or C; status D is allowed for a recovered-dead juvenile with a complete recovered combination in the _in fields.
CR adult captures must use LL as one of YR, YO, YY, GY, BY, WY, OY, or LY; dead-on-capture status D rows may leave UL, LL, UR, and LR blank.
Non-CR adult captures must not use the CR adult LL combinations YR, YO, YY, GY, BY, WY, OY, or LY.
Adult captures may not use the chick or juvenile release marking schemes.
Chick and juvenile captures must leave tag-related leg codes blank.
Chick and juvenile captures must leave tag fields blank.
Short UR tag codes such as TY are reserved for GEO tags.
Release GEO tag code requires tag_id.
Input GEO tag code requires tag_id_in.
Release GEO tags must use a short upper-leg T code such as TY.
Input GEO tags must use a short upper-leg T code such as TY.
Release GEO tag codes require tag_action D, S, or N.
Input GEO tag codes require tag_action S, N, or R.
tag_action D means the bird must not already carry a tag in the input combo.
tag_action R means the bird must not retain a tag in the release combo.
tag_action O can only be used when no tag is present at capture or release.
tag_type must be blank when no tag is present.
tag_action must be O when no tag is present.
tag_action D requires the newly deployed tag in tag_id.
tag_action D requires tag_id_in to be blank.
tag_action R requires the retrieved tag in tag_id_in.
tag_action R requires release tag_id to be blank.
tag_action S requires the retained tag in tag_id_in.
tag_action S requires the retained tag in tag_id.
tag_action S requires the same tag_id before and after release.
tag_action N requires the removed tag in tag_id_in.
tag_action N requires the newly deployed tag in tag_id.
tag_action N requires different input and release tag IDs.
wt_w_tag must be 0 or 1 when a capture involves a tag.

rules.title: CAP_017B tag history
messages: Tag history could not be checked because saved CAPTURES records were unavailable.
This tag_id was already deployed and may only be deployed again after an earlier retrieval recorded with tag_action R and the tag in tag_id_in.
tag_action S requires this tag to be active on the same ring from an earlier deployment.
tag_action R requires tag_id_in to be active on the same ring from an earlier deployment.
tag_action N requires tag_id_in to identify an active tag previously deployed with tag_action D to this ring.
tag_action N requires a new release tag_id that has not previously been deployed to any bird.

rules.title: CAP_015B first nest event
rules.messages: Positive nest-linked capture events require a same-day-or-earlier NESTS F discovery event for this nest_id.

rules.title: CAP_016 prior combo
messages: Prior-combination checks could not be completed because
CAPTURES_ARCHIVE is unavailable; no conclusion was made about
whether this release combination exists. Please retry after
the database connection is restored.
Status R requires a release combo already present in capture history.
whether this input combination exists. Please retry after
Status C requires an input combo already present in capture history.

rules.title: CAP_018 024 027 age fields
messages: Adult captures require this morphometric field.
Adult captures must record brood_patch as 0 or 1.
Adult captures require at least one moult score in moult_left or moult_right.
Adult captures must record breast_samp as 0 or 1.
Adult captures must record primary_samp as 0 or 1.
Adult captures require feather_wear from 0 to 3.
Adult captures require feather_wear from 0 to 3 when entered.
Adult captures require fat from 1 to 8.
parents must be blank for adult captures.
Adult captures must record mugshot_photo as 0 or 1.
Adult captures must record wing_photo as 0 or 1.
Adult captures must leave chick_tent_photo blank or use 0.
Adult captures must leave chick_hide_photo blank or use 0.
Chick captures require this morphometric field.
This morphometric field must be blank for chick captures.
brood_patch must be blank for chick captures.
Moult fields must be blank for chick captures.
feather_wear must be blank for chick captures.
fat must be blank for chick captures.
When entered for a status-C chick capture, brood_patch must be 0 or 1.
When entered for a status-C chick capture, feather_wear must be 0, 1, 2, or 3.
When entered for a status-C chick capture, fat must be from 1 to 8.
parents for chicks must be MF, F, M, U1, U2, or O.
When entered for a status-C chick capture, breast_samp must be 0 or 1.
When entered for a status-C chick capture, primary_samp must be 0 or 1.
Chick captures must use breast_samp 0 or blank.
Chick captures must use primary_samp 0 or blank.
All chick captures must record chick_tent_photo as 0 or 1.
All chick captures must record chick_hide_photo as 0 or 1.
must be blank for chick captures.
Juvenile captures require this morphometric field.
This morphometric field must be blank for juvenile captures.
brood_patch must be blank for juvenile captures.
parents for juveniles must be MF, F, M, U1, U2, or O.
Juvenile captures must use breast_samp 0 or blank.
Juvenile captures must use primary_samp 0 or blank.
Juvenile captures must leave chick_tent_photo blank or use 0.
Juvenile captures must leave chick_hide_photo blank or use 0.
All captures must record blood_samp as blank, BQ, BF, or BE.

rules.title: CAP_021B eggs handled
messages: eggs_handled must be 0 or 1 when entered.
Adult captures with nest_id must record eggs_handled as 0 or 1.
eggs_handled must be blank for chick captures.
eggs_handled must be blank for juvenile captures.

rules.title: CAP_028 photo fields
messages: cam_id is required when any photo flag is 1.
photo_start is required when any photo flag is 1.
photo_end is required when any photo flag is 1.
cam_id, photo_start, and photo_end must all be filled together.
photo_end sequence must not be earlier than photo_start.

rules.title: CAP_026 max chicks
rules.messages: No simultaneous capture event may contain more than three chicks.

rules.title: GLOBAL_005 photo unique
rules.messages: Photo range overlaps an image number already used by the same camera in another event. Multiple age-C H rows from the same camera/date/nest_id or complete GPS-linked photo session may share a range.

rules.title: observer upload initials
messages: all capture events require the observer code of the person entering the record to the database
Observer-upload codes must use two or three uppercase letters or digits.

rules.title: caught with format
rules.messages: Caught-with entry must use the current comma-separated format.

rules.title: comma leg markings
rules.messages: do not comma-seperate leg markings, e.g., "R,R" should be "RR"

rules.title: left tibia in
rules.messages: Left tibia code at capture does not match the current format.

rules.title: left tarsus in
rules.messages: Left tarsus code at capture does not match the current format.

rules.title: right tibia in
rules.messages: Right tibia code at capture does not match the current format.

rules.title: right tarsus in
rules.messages: Right tarsus code at capture does not match the current format.

rules.title: moult format
rules.messages: Moult score must use the current scoring format, e.g. 0(10) or 2(1) 0(9).

rules.title: tag type required
rules.messages: Tag type is required when tag ID is entered.

rules.title: tag id in format
rules.messages: Tag ID at capture has unexpected characters.

rules.title: tag id format
rules.messages: Tag ID at release has unexpected characters.

rules.title: camera id format
rules.messages: Camera ID must use the current two- or three-character format.

rules.title: photo filename format
rules.messages: Photo filename has unexpected characters.

rules.title: CAP_007 008 likely patterns
messages: Chick captures usually use capture_status F, R, or C; D is valid for a recovered-dead chick. Please confirm the status matches the bird's capture history.
This looks like a juvenile capture. Please check capture_status; juveniles usually use F or C, while D is valid for a recovered-dead juvenile.
This looks like a chick capture. Please check capture_method; chick captures usually use HA.
Please check capture_method. Adult and juvenile captures usually use MM or TN; age-A HA captures are allowed only under the separate HA timing and nest-linkage rule.

rules.title: CAP_W012 post-hatch brood mixing
messages: This age-C R/C capture uses a different nest_id from the chick's earlier F capture.
Post-hatch brood mixing can make that biologically correct; please verify the ring, date, and location rather than automatically reverting to the F-event nest.

rules.title: CAP_011 nest sex count
rules.messages: This nest_id has more than one adult recorded as the same sex. That can happen, but please check the sex, nest_id, and leg marks before continuing.

rules.title: CAP_W011 parent spacing
rules.messages: These parents were caught less than 36 hours apart. Please minimise further disturbance where possible, because repeated visits can increase the risk of desertion.

rules.title: CAP_016B adult nest target
rules.messages: This is a full-combination recapture. That is usually expected only for first marking, immature remarking, or tag deployment, so please check that the event and marks are correct.

rules.title: CAP_012 duplicate ring
rules.messages: This ring already appears in current or historical capture records. Please check that the ring was copied correctly and belongs to this bird.

rules.title: CAP_012B duplicate markings
messages: This complete band combination (UL/LL/UR/LR) is already associated
with another ring. A metal band on UL is common and is not the problem
by itself; please check the full combination and ring. If two birds
genuinely share the same combination, add a comment and arrange correction.

rules.title: CAP_015 hatch evidence warning
rules.messages: This chick or juvenile is linked to a positive nest_id, but the nest history does not yet show prior or same-day hatch evidence. Please check NESTS and add or correct the appropriate nest_state H event if hatch signs were observed.

rules.title: CAP_025 caught with
rules.messages: Please check caught_with against the birds handled at the same time. It should usually describe the brood composition present during this capture.

rules.title: CAP_W001 daylight
rules.messages: This capture time is outside the usual 07:00–19:00 field window. Please check the time; if it is correct, keep it and add a brief note if helpful.

rules.title: CAP_W002 GPS default
rules.messages: This GPS ID is different from the observer’s usual GPS. Please check that the correct device and waypoint were entered.

rules.title: CAP_W004 blood sample review
rules.messages: Please check blood_samp. Most capture samples use BQ, but keep this value if another sample type was genuinely collected.

rules.title: CAP_W009 morphometric limits
messages: C_recap

These measurements are large enough to warrant flagging (i.e., capture_status C with an engraved flag in UL). Please double-check that your capture_status and/or measures are correct. If correct, add a validator bypass comment to the event.
This measurement is unusual for the selected age group. Please recheck the measurement and units; if it is correct, keep it and add a note if needed.

rules.title: CAP_W010 tibia placement
messages: This tarsus code is unusual. Please check that the colour code is correct; usual colour codes are B, G, R, O, W, L, or Y.

These look like coloured bands may have been entered on the tibia. Please check whether they belong on the tarsus fields LL/LR; tibia fields normally contain flags, metal M, a geolocator code such as TY, or X/blank.
This tibia code is unusual. Please check the entry; tibia fields normally contain a flag, metal M, a geolocator code such as TY, or X/blank.

rules.title: CAP_W011 photo flags
rules.messages: Photo details are present, but none of the photo flags is set to 1. Please check the photo flags and mark the photo type that was actually taken.

rules.title: GLOBAL_W003 gps timestamp
rules.messages: The GPS waypoint time is more than two hours from the first use of this gps_id/gps_point. Please check the gps_id/gps_point and event date/time; sometimes a device clock is the little culprit here.

rules.title: EGG_001 mandatory
rules.messages: Required EGGS field.

rules.title: EGG_002 observer active
rules.messages: Observer must exist in OBSERVERS and be active on the egg date.

rules.title: EGG_003 event timing
messages: All EGGS rows for the same egg-check event must use the same date.
All EGGS rows for the same nest_id on the same date must use time_visit values within five minutes.

rules.title: GLOBAL_002 season
rules.messages: Date must fall within the 2026-2027 field season.

rules.title: EGG_004 nest id
rules.messages: A negative nest_id describes a brood of unknown origin and has no known nest or egg history. Enter each observed bird in RESIGHTINGS or each captured bird in CAPTURES instead; EGGS requires a positive nest_id.

rules.title: EGG_006 float logic
messages: float_surface must be blank when float_location is bottom.
float_surface must be blank when float_location is suspended.
when float_location is "surface" a "float_surface" value (0, 1, 2, or 3) is needed indicating the mm above the surface

rules.title: EGG_009 egg id event
messages: egg_id must be unique within an EGGS event.
egg_id must not exceed the clutch_size of the matching NESTS event.

rules.title: coded values
rules.messages: Value is not in the current allowed set.

rules.title: observer initials
rules.messages: Observer codes must use two or three uppercase letters or digits.

rules.title: date format
rules.messages: Date must use YYYY-MM-DD.

rules.title: time format
rules.messages: Visit time must use hh:mm.

rules.title: egg id
rules.messages: Egg ID must be a whole number from 1 to 4.

rules.title: float angle
rules.messages: Float angle must be a whole number from 0 to 90.

rules.title: float surface
rules.messages: Float-surface height must be a non-negative whole number.

rules.title: EGG_W003A angle by location
messages: The angle looks unusual for an egg floating at the bottom. Please check the float_location and angle, and correct either one if needed.
The angle looks unusual for a suspended egg. Please check the float_location and angle, and correct either one if needed.
The angle looks unusual for a surface-floating egg. Please check the float_location and angle, and correct either one if needed.

rules.title: EGG_W004 stage spread
rules.messages: The floatation results suggest that eggs in this nest may differ in developmental stage by more than seven days. Please double-check the readings and dates; the eggs may simply be keeping us on our toes.

rules.title: EGG_005 event match
rules.messages: This EGGS event does not closely match a NESTS visit by nest_id, date, observer, and time. Please check the linkage and time_visit; if the records belong together, make the entries consistent.

rules.title: EGG_007 starred no float
rules.messages: This egg is marked as starred or pipping but also has floatation data. Please check the observation; eggs showing these signs are usually left un-floated.

rules.title: required nest fields
rules.messages: Required nest field.

rules.title: coded values
rules.messages: Value is not in the current allowed set.

rules.title: other state comment
rules.messages: nest_state O requires a comment describing the observation.

rules.title: observer initials
rules.messages: Observer codes must use two or three uppercase letters or digits.

rules.title: observer active
rules.messages: Observer must be in OBSERVERS and active on the visit date.

rules.title: hatch state clutch count
messages: hatch_state describes
egg(s), but clutch_size is
. Remember that C means a cracked egg; chicks belong in brood_size. Check hatch_state and clutch_size.

rules.title: GLOBAL_005A gps points
messages: Could not confirm gps_id and gps_point against GPS_POINTS. Confirm the GPS was uploaded via gpxui before entering events.
gps_id and gps_point must already exist in GPS_POINTS. Upload the GPS first via gpxui.

rules.title: date season
rules.messages: Date must use YYYY-MM-DD and fall within the 2026-2027 field season.

rules.title: time format
rules.messages: Visit time must use hh:mm.

rules.title: nest id pattern
messages: A negative nest_id describes a brood of unknown origin and cannot be entered in NESTS. Enter each observed bird in RESIGHTINGS or each captured bird in CAPTURES using that negative nest_id.
nest_id values beginning with WR are WRYB nest_id values. Set species to WRYB.
nest_id values beginning with A, B, C, or BA are BADO nest_id values. Set species to BADO.
CR
WRYB
Cass River WRYB nest_id must use WR + gps_id + sequence, e.g. WR0201.
Cass River BADO nest_id must use plot + gps_id + sequence, e.g. B0112.
Non-CR BADO nest_id must use BA + gps_id + sequence, e.g. BA0804.

rules.title: hatch state format
rules.messages: Hatch state must use a positive count followed by C, S, N, or CC for each component; component order does not matter.

rules.title: gps id
rules.messages: GPS ID must be a positive whole number.

rules.title: gps point
rules.messages: GPS point must be a positive whole number.

rules.title: clutch size
rules.messages: Clutch size must be a non-negative whole number.

rules.title: brood size
rules.messages: Brood size must be a non-negative whole number.

rules.title: brood requires clutch
rules.messages: clutch_size must be entered whenever brood_size is entered. Enter the observed clutch size, using 0 when no eggs remain.

rules.title: hatch state for brood
rules.messages: When clutch_size is 0 and brood_size is positive, nest_state must be H rather than I: the eggs have hatched, but chicks are still present.

rules.title: camera id
rules.messages: Camera ID must use the current two- or three-character format.

rules.title: photo filename
rules.messages: Photo filename has unexpected characters.

rules.title: photo metadata
messages: cam_id is required when nest_photo or tent_photo is 1.
photo_start is required when nest_photo or tent_photo is 1.
photo_end is required when nest_photo or tent_photo is 1.
cam_id, photo_start, and photo_end must all be filled together.
photo_end sequence must not be earlier than photo_start.

rules.title: nest history starts
messages: The first chronological nest event must use nest_state S or F.
A first nest event with clutch_size 0 must use nest_state S.
The first nest event for a nest_id must record gps_id.
The first nest event for a nest_id must record gps_point.
Each nest_id may contain only one nest_state F event.
Only the first chronological event for a nest_id may record gps_id.
Only the first chronological event for a nest_id may record gps_point.

rules.title: start state sequence
messages: F
After nest_state F, subsequent visits may use only I, H, pP, P, pD, D, notA, or O.
S
After nest_state S, subsequent visits may use only S, F, or a final notA.
This nest_state is not allowed after the latest active nest state.

rules.title: terminal notA
messages: notA must be the final visit and can only follow S, F, H, pD, pP, P, or D.
When paired with D, notA may use the same timestamp but must not occur before D.
Only a final notA visit may follow a terminal H visit with clutch_size 0 and brood_size greater than 0. Follow-up pP, P, D, and pD visits are allowed while the nest is being checked before closure.
H cannot be followed by I in the same nest history.

rules.title: notA inactive row
messages: notA rows must leave hatch_state blank.
notA rows must set clutch_size to 0 unless they immediately follow a D row
in the same submission and retain that D row's clutch_size.
S rows must set clutch_size to 0.
S rows must leave brood_size blank or set it to 0.

rules.title: hatch progression
rules.messages: Hatch-state progression cannot move backward.

rules.title: photo numbers unique
rules.messages: Photo range overlaps an image number already used by the same camera in NESTS, CAPTURES, RESIGHTINGS, or another current row. Multiple age-C H rows may share a range when they document the same nest/brood photo session.

rules.title: NEST_014 discovery tally
messages: nest_id tally
is already assigned to another discovered nest or scrape, and no unused two-digit tally remains for this GPS ID.
is already assigned to another discovered nest or scrape. The next available tally for this GPS ID is likely

rules.title: hatch state review
rules.messages: Please check hatch_state. Use the project’s hatch-sign format and make sure the counts are biologically plausible—usually no more than three eggs.

rules.title: pP/P to D review
rules.messages: This nest changed from pP/P to D. That is allowed, but unusual; please confirm the nest was truly deserted and continue follow-up checks as needed before recording the final notA visit.

rules.title: asynchronous hatch_state
rules.messages: Hatching appears to be asynchronous: the previous visit recorded hatch signs, and this visit still has both egg(s) and chick(s). Please record the hatch signs you observed today in hatch_state.

rules.title: observer defaults
messages: This GPS ID is different from the observer’s usual GPS. Please check that the correct device and waypoint were entered.
This camera is different from the observer’s usual camera. Please check the camera ID against the photo files and keep it only if another camera was genuinely used.

rules.title: photo clutch size
rules.messages: This visit includes photo or hatch information, but clutch_size is blank. Please enter the clutch size observed today; use 0 when no eggs were present.

rules.title: clutch progression
messages: Clutch size has decreased before hatch. Please check the egg count and dates; if the decrease is real, add a note explaining what happened.
Clutch size increased after hatch signs were observed for this nest. Please check the egg counts and dates; if an earlier count was incomplete or corrected, explain the change in comments.
This nest started below a full clutch, but the next visit did not show an increase. Please check the clutch counts and add a note if the smaller clutch is expected.

rules.title: offspring total
rules.messages: More than three offspring are recorded here. Please double-check clutch_size and brood_size—perhaps there is a very enthusiastic counting error hiding in the sheet.

rules.title: brood without eggs
rules.messages: No eggs were detected, so this is no longer an active nest record. Please record each chick as its own RESIGHTINGS event, or as a CAPTURES event if it was handled.

rules.title: predated row counts
messages: This pP/P event has a non-zero clutch_size. Please check the nest state and enter 0 if no eggs were present.
This pP/P event has a brood_size recorded. Please check the nest state and leave brood_size blank or enter 0 unless chicks were genuinely present.

rules.title: H row review
rules.messages: This H event does not fully agree with brood_size, clutch_size, and hatch_state. Please check the three fields together and correct them if needed.

rules.title: photo event review
rules.messages: This nest history contains more than one photo event. Please check whether the repeated photo record is intentional and that the photo ranges are correct.

rules.title: photo flags
rules.messages: Photo details are present, but neither nest_photo nor tent_photo is set to 1. Please mark the photo type that was actually taken.

rules.title: GLOBAL_W003 gps timestamp
rules.messages: The GPS waypoint time is more than two hours from the first use of this gps_id/gps_point. Please check the gps_id/gps_point and event date/time; sometimes a device clock is the little culprit here.

rules.title: observer initials
rules.messages: Observer codes must use two or three uppercase letters or digits.

rules.title: start date
rules.messages: Start date must use YYYY-MM-DD.

rules.title: stop date
rules.messages: Stop date must use YYYY-MM-DD.

rules.title: gps id
rules.messages: GPS ID must be a whole number from 1 to 255, or a comma-separated list of those values.

rules.title: nznbbs number
rules.messages: NZNBBS number must use four letters or numbers.

rules.title: OBS_002 start stop
rules.messages: Observer start must be on or before stop.

rules.title: OBS_003 unique observer
rules.messages: Observer code must be unique.

rules.title: RES_001 mandatory
messages: Required resighting field.
H-class resighting fields must be present.
gps_id and gps_point must be entered together; positive nest-linked rows should ordinarily leave both blank.
Hiding-spot photo events require both gps_id and gps_point, even when nest_id is recorded.
Negative nest_id values identify broods found after hatching and require both gps_id and gps_point because there is no NESTS location.
A GPS ID and GPS point are required when this resighting is not linked to a positive nest.
At least one leg-mark segment must be entered.

rules.title: RES_011 H chick band layout
messages: For an H-class chick, UR = M means UL must be blank.
For an H-class chick, if UR is blank, UL must contain the single metal band M.
For an H-class chick, a single colour band in LL means LR must be blank.
For an H-class chick, if LL is blank, LR must contain one colour band: B, G, R, O, W, L, or Y.

rules.title: RES_010 H ring
rules.messages: A metal-ring code is required for a hiding-spot-photo event (rclass H).

rules.title: GLOBAL_002 season
rules.messages: Date must fall within the 2026-2027 field season.

rules.title: RES_005F first nest event
messages: Positive nest-linked RESIGHTINGS events require a same-day-or-earlier NESTS F, I, or H event.

Adult scraping (SC) or nonconfirming observations may instead use a same-day-or-earlier S scrape while S is still the latest nest state; IN/NM, BW, and BC/FC/AC follow their separate nest-stage rules.

rules.title: RES_009B photo rclass
rules.messages: When cam_id, photo_start, and photo_end are entered, rclass must be V, P, or H.

rules.title: GLOBAL_005A gps points
messages: Could not confirm gps_id and gps_point against GPS_POINTS. Confirm the GPS was uploaded via gpxui before entering events.
gps_id and gps_point must already exist in GPS_POINTS. Upload the GPS first via gpxui.

rules.title: RES_002 observer active

rules.title: RES_003 rclass

rules.title: RES_004 sex age
messages: Sex must be M, MU, F, FU, or U.
Age must be A, J, or C.
Chick and juvenile resightings must use sex U.
Hiding-spot-photo resightings (rclass H) must use age C.

rules.title: RES_004B behav age
rules.messages: Chick and juvenile resightings can only use OB, FT, AT, LF, RS, FF, FA, FC, or PR.

rules.title: RES_004C nest id
messages: NO_NEST is no longer accepted. Leave nest_id blank for an unrelated resighting and enter both gps_id and gps_point, or enter the appropriate positive or negative nest_id.
CR
Cass River nest_id must use plot + gps_id + sequence, e.g. B0112 or -B0203.
Non-CR nest_id values must use the species prefix plus four digits, e.g. BA0804 or -BA0804.

rules.title: RES_005B nest link
messages: This same family occasion contains conflicting nest_id values across the parent/chick records. Keep one nest_id for the same date, site, gps_id, and gps_point; use a different nest_id only for a separate encounter or a genuinely different brood association.
Adult IN/NM/SC/BW/BC/FC/AC nest-association resightings must record both LL and LR.
Enter X or XX when the lower leg is explicitly unbanded; blank lower fields cannot independently confirm the nest or brood link.

rules.title: RES_005D ended nest
rules.messages: Adult IN/NM resightings require a nest_id whose latest nest_state is F, I, or H. If this nest has reached another state, check the nest linkage or enter the new nest_id for a new breeding attempt.

rules.title: RES_005J same-session family link
messages: Each age-C RESIGHTINGS event must be accompanied in this portal session by an age-A parent event with behav BC, FC, or AC, linked by the same nest_id or gps_id/gps_point. Enter the parent event and keep the linkage consistent.

Awesome that you saw a banded parent with chicks! However, no associated age-C event was found for this field occasion. If the chicks were captured, save the genuine age-C CAPTURES rows first and make sure they use the same date, site, gps_id, and gps_point as the parent. If they were observed but not captured, enter a rclass 'R' RESIGHTINGS event for each chick with the colour band seen, linked to the tending parent with the same gps_id and gps_point. 'ring' can be left blank.

rules.title: RES_005K brood-stage state
messages: Parent-with-chicks behavior BC/FC/AC requires a linked nest_id whose latest nest_state is H or notA. Check the nest state or nest linkage.
This nest_id has reached notA while chicks remain mobile; enter both gps_id and gps_point for the parent/chick association.

photo_end sequence must not be earlier than photo_start.
